description.value: The Fraser River Discovery Centre is a museum dedicated to the ecology, history, and cultural significance of the Fraser River, situated on the New Westminster waterfront on the traditional territory of the hən̓q̓əmin̓əm̓ and Halq̓eméylem speaking peoples. The centre offers permanent and temporary exhibits, Indigenous education programming, guided tours, and summer camps. A touring cyclist following the Fraser River route would find this a meaningful cultural stop along the waterfront.
